name: Harkoni
notes: Reptilian bipeds with dense muscle structure and hardened physiology suited to extreme environments; a martial culture valuing strategy, discipline, and honor. Primary polity: Harkon Sovereignty.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Harkoni" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: The people of the Harkon Sovereignty. The Sovereignty is the STATE; Harkoni is the PEOPLE — internally divided (loyalists vs isolationists) and not reducible to their government.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.
